The Periodic Notes daily template (`Templates/Daily note.md` in the vault):

```markdown
# {{date:dddd, D MMMM YYYY}}

## Inbox

{{< meta facts.marker.inbox_start >}}
{{< meta facts.marker.inbox_end >}}

{{< meta facts.vault.log_heading >}}

- 
```

The heading text {{< meta facts.vault.log_heading >}} must match exactly. The inbox markers can sit anywhere; if they're missing, `gh-inbox` adds them at the end of the note.
